underlines.text: That she should have walked three miles so early in the day

reference.text: The distance is nothing, when one has a motive; only three miles.

underlines.text: from expressing in her note how much she longed for such a visit
the extraordinary kindness she was treated with

reference.text: My kind friends will not hear of my returning home till I am better.

underlines.text: Elizabeth began to like them herself

reference.text: That she should have walked three miles so early in the day in such dirty weather, and by herself, was almost incredible to Mrs. Hurst and Miss Bingley; and Elizabeth was convinced that they held her in contempt for it.
They insist also on my seeing Mr. Jones—therefore do not be alarmed if you should hear of his having been to me—and, excepting a sore throat and a headache, there is not much the matter with me.
